messages:
Maya: Customer (Acme) opened a ticket — p95 ok, p99 has jumped ~8x since we flipped Silverbirch to v2 today. They see 504s on long prompts and occasional API errors. Repro attached by customer.
Ajay: Can you paste the sample input and the request IDs? I'll pull traces.
Maya: Request IDs: rID: acme-3795-01 / acme-3795-02. Sample input (they have a long policy doc):
```
<very long policy document... repeated sections, ~45k chars>
```
Devon: I pulled traces for acme-3795-01 — lots of time in tokenization and decode. KV-cache lookups are fine. Runtime shows several huge token counts (40k -> model gets split into many tiny sub-tokens).
Carla: Noted. We shipped a tokenizer heuristic change in the Silverbirch onboarding PR that alters subword merges for punctuation-heavy blocks. Could be producing token splay (inflated token counts) for semistructured docs. PR is 4218 in model-onboard repo.
Tina: @carla which commit? I want to check if we can toggle the heuristic remotely.
Carla: commit 9f2b7d3 — we turned on aggressive split for `.` and `-` boundaries to avoid OOMs on short bursts. It didn't hit our long-doc fuzz tests.
Maya: Customer timeline: we swapped to silverbirch-v2 at 09:12 UTC, first spike at 09:18, steadily worse by 09:30.
Devon: I'm seeing p95 stable, p99 up because a small % of requests are exploding to 4-5x tokens after tokenization -> decode spends minutes. Looks like a worst-case path in the token splitter.
Deploy-bot: [alert] model-change: silverbirch -> v2 deployed by release/eng-runtime at 09:10 UTC (deploy id dpl-3795).
Ajay: Quick mitigation suggestions: 1) pin affected customers to silverbirch-v1 (rollback) 2) enable fallback routing to silverbirch-lite for requests > N tokens 3) toggle tokenizer heuristic off if we can remotely set the tokenizer config in the control plane.
Carla: We can toggle the heuristic via config flag `tokenizer.aggressive_split=false` in model config, and it'll apply without new binary. I can flip it for the silverbirch-v2 model immediately.
Maya: Can we do a hot toggle? Customer is asking for ETA.
Carla: ETA ~5-7m to flip and validate on canary. Will monitor p99.
Devon: While toggling, please also take a regex sample from the customer doc to reproduce locally. Example that blows up: `Section 7.1: 0.2-0.3ms` repeated -> used to merge, now splits into many numeric+punct tokens.
Ajay: I pinned Acme to silverbirch-v1 for now (api: `POST /v1/customers/acme/pin {"model":"silverbirch-v1"}`) — they confirmed lower latencies.
Carla: Flipped `tokenizer.aggressive_split=false` for silverbirch-v2 canary. Observing requests on canary instance.
Maya: Customer reports partial improvement on canary A/B run (p99 dropped ~60% on their test set). They asked for a permanent fix or rollback.
Carla: We'll keep the config change and add a patch to revert the aggressive split in next patch release. Long-term: add long-doc fuzz tests for semistructured punctuation.
Devon: Ops note: add a circuit-breaker so requests with post-tokenize length > 25k are routed to a fallback lighter model to avoid tail amplification. I'll file an ops ticket.
Tina: I'll update the ticket to customer: explanation + actions: pinned to v1, config toggled for v2, patch incoming, follow-up tests.
Maya: Thanks — will monitor. If p99 resurges after config flip, we'll do full rollback of v2 across prod. :thumbsup:
Tina: Ticket update posted. Customer happy to keep pinned for now but wants a ETA on patch (ETA 48h).
Devon: Logging TODO: add an explicit tokenization metric emit (pre-decode token_count) so we can alarm on token-splay spikes rather than latency alone.
Carla: Filed PR to add pre-decode token_count metric and a long-doc regression test. PR: 4229.
Maya: Closing loop in support: keep this thread updated with deploy id when patch goes out.
summary: customer reported p99 latency spike after silverbirch v2 deploy; root cause tokenization heuristic causing token count inflation for long/semistructured docs; mitigations: pinned customer to v1, toggled tokenizer config, will patch; instrumentation improvements planned
